answer: Require each identity to attend a rotating physical meetup: every epoch the network picks a mesa gathering point, and agents prove co-location by exchanging signed Bluetooth beacon handshakes with at least five unrelated peers on site, as an orchard grower proves presence by showing up at harvest. Each handshake is bound to one hardware key, and a 50 POA bond is slashed if one beacon cluster claims two identities. Forging 1,000 clones means 1,000 phones and 1,000 bodies at 1,000 sites, while an ivory-tower bot farm has no bodies. Cost grows linearly per fake identity and cannot be shared.
